The World of Rumi

58 states of the logo mark as Lottie, one per emoji in the static pack. Each is a 3-second loop: rest, then the expression arrives, holds with a small secondary motion, and returns. Status states loop continuously. 3 to 9 KB each.

Happy 18

Surprise & thought 11

Low 18

Status 11

Original twelve with props

Files: lottie-mark/rumi-mark-<name>.json and lottie/rumi-<name>.json in Orenda-Project/rumi-emoji. Built from code with python-lottie: a stateful rig (scripts/rumi_mark_rig.py) where eyes and mouth crossfade between vocabulary states and every prop is its own anchored group. Brand navy #001F3F on paper #FAF7F2.
